title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-07-01
lineage: Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav > cdwav > soundforge 6 where necessary for patching > Flac (sector boundaries aligned via flac frontend)
source: Schoeps cmc441 (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1 (Oade brothers, via Darrin Sacks)

ai_review.summary: Warm Oade audience tape captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a ripping Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence and a rock‑and‑roll post‑drum jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid Oade audience capture – clear enough to feel right in the pavilion with only minimal chatter.  Musically the concert shines, especially the blistering Scarlet Begonias/Fire on the Mountain transition, a fire‑filled Fire finale and an electrifying post‑drum jam that reviewers call “rock‑and‑roll”.  Overall both the performance and the tape are consistently praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.8 stars; comments praise both the show (standout jams, setlist) and the recording (warm, clear Oade audience), yielding a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical Oade audience tape – warm tone, clear pavilion ambience, very little chatter, no noticeable drop‑outs; feels like being right there.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic pacing with a strong second‑half; the Scarlet Begonias/Fire sequence and the post‑drum jam are highlighted as high points.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice licks at the end of Fire on the Mountain are specifically praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: The post‑drum jam is described as rock‑and‑roll intense.
